description: This file defines the class HttpContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider, which provides mechanisms to extract tenant and authentication identifier information from an HTTP context, including handling SSL client certificates and authorization headers. It is part of a service layer in an Eclipse Hono-based system.

classes.name: HttpContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: A provider class that extracts tenant and authentication ID information from an HTTP context, supporting extraction from SSL client certificates and HTTP authorization headers.

methods.name: HttpContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
methods.description: Constructor to initialize with configuration and tenant client factory; optionally with parameter names for tenant ID and device ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant and auth-id info from the HTTP context, attempting to parse from client certificate or headers depending on configuration.

methods.name: getFromClientCertificate
methods.description: Extracts tenant and auth-id from SSL client certificate, if the connection is encrypted and certificates are present.

methods.name: getFromAuthHeader
methods.description: Retrieves tenant and auth-id information based on the HTTP Authorization header, supporting Basic auth scheme.
